key_lines: Positions Available: 2027 Operations Cadetship Program

Mawsons Concrete and Quarries produce quality construction materials throughout Northern Victoria and Southern NSW and has a successful business history spanning over 110 years across regional communities. Mawsons growth in recent years has taken it to over 550 employees across 80 sites. Mawsons enjoys the backing and support that comes with being part of a wider enterprise owned by Adbri and in turn CRH. As an employer of choice, Mawsons offer industry competitive remuneration and flexible work opportunities.

This is the fifth year Mawsons are running our extremely successful Operations Cadetship Program. This is an exciting opportunity for young people aged 18-25 to complete a 10-month cadetship commencing in late January 2027. Our goal is to secure local talent and provide development opportunities and experiences to young people in the communities in which we work. Mawsons also welcomes applications from school leavers over the age of 18.

The successful candidates will be rotated through four of our primary operations areas; concrete, quarries, technical and workshops (mechanical & fabrication). Each cadet will be assigned a Mawsons mentor to provide meaningful, practical support and guidance throughout the cadetship. During this hands-on program Cadets will have the opportunity to gain valuable industry experience, practical skills, training, and workplace knowledge from our friendly, professional teams whilst earning a competitive wage.

At the successful completion of the cadetship the objective is for each participant to be offered a suitable permanent on-going role with Mawsons dependent on their skills, preferences, desired work location and the business needs at that time.
Essential Criteria
• Current drivers licence (mandatory)

This cadetship provides a great opportunity to become part of a successful company known for its steadiness and strong commitment to safety, innovation, and quality. The successful cadet will receive comprehensive on-the-job training from a supportive team, along with opportunities to grow and develop professionally.
To complete an Application Form please go to the following link: https://www.mawsons.com.au/cadetships
Applications Close: Friday 23rd October 2026
